archetypes.name: dyn-dependency-migration
archetypes.rationale: Dependency migration mutates a live graph through retryable persisted state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed decompose migration flow for authorization-before-read, add-before-remove ordering, live readback, stale sentinel handling, and idempotent retry. Check that closure cannot run unless the full graph still verifies. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
